verdicts.reason: A: the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has moved below the headline and shrunk until it can't be read, the orange divider rule is stranded at the very bottom under the legal copy, and the legal text is almost as large as the body copy. B has the same eyebrow and legal-text problems, and its header band is squeezed thin, so the logo is tiny and the sun mark is barely visible or lost. B's divider sits more sensibly above the headline, but A keeps the logo more intact, so A is marginally better.
